meta.title: PLUS ADVISOR

footer.description: PLUS Advisor is a family office in Indonesia, dedicated to guiding families in planning, structuring, protecting, and sustaining their legacy—so it may endure with clarity, care, and continuity across generations.
footer.whistleBody: Every family has its own needs. At Plus Advisor, we listen, understand your direction, and keep every conversation confidential—laying the groundwork for lasting peace of mind.
footer.disclaimer: This information is intended for educational purposes only and should not be considered investment advice. All investment decisions are made at the sole discretion and responsibility of the investor.

familyLegacy.body: PLUS Advisor stands beside families where responsibility grows and decisions carry weight. Through clarity, due care, and independent advisory, we help protect what matters and sustain peace of mind across generations.
familyLegacy.footnote: We guide how your wealth is preserved and passed on across generations—through estate and succession planning aligned with your family’s long-term vision.

pillars.title: Wealth Assessment
pillars.description: Every journey begins with understanding. We take the time to develop a comprehensive view of your financial landscape, including assets, risks, priorities, and what matters most to you. This assessment provides clarity where informed decisions can begin.

pillars.title: Advisory
pillars.lead: Not every decision should be made alone.
pillars.description: We provide an independent perspective on financial products or proposals, helping you see beyond what is presented—so you can move forward with confidence and assurance.

pillars.title: Advisor Oversight & Governance
pillars.lead: Good advice deserves a strong foundation.
pillars.description: Advisors within PLUS Advisor are supported by clear ethical standards, thoughtful review, and legal guidance—ensuring that every advice is delivered with care, responsibility, and integrity.

pillars.title: Family Office Services
pillars.lead: Wealth is more than numbers—it carries meaning across generations.
pillars.description: We help families plan, preserve, and govern their wealth with intention, so what has been built can continue to support the family's objectives, values, and harmony over time.

pillars.title: Fraud Prevention & Response Advisory
pillars.description: We help you identify early potential signs of risk, be informed, and navigate potential complex situations so adequate response can be improved with confidence and informed judgment.

office.intro: We guide families through financial complexity with a clear, disciplined approach—protecting today's stability and ensuring tomorrow's legacy.

slides.title: Wealth Planning
slides.subtitle: Structuring What Is Meant to Be Carried Forward
slides.body: We provide guidance in shaping how what you have built is preserved and passed on—through estate planning, including lifetime gifting, life insurance, prenuptial arrangements, and wills, as well as succession planning to support business continuity. Each step is aligned with your intentions and the long-term direction of the family.

aboutPlusAdvisor.title: About Plus Advisor
aboutPlusAdvisor.subtitle: Guided with Clarity, Carried with Care.
paragraphs: PLUS Advisor is a family office and advisory firm based in Indonesia, working with individuals and families across borders. We support those navigating complexity with clarity and due care, where decisions carry weight and unresolved matters as much as outcome.

As a family office, we bring together the many dimensions of wealth, including financial, structural, and generational considerations, into a more considered whole. Each element is approached in relation to one another, forming a direction that is coherent, deliberate, and quietly assured.
Through time and careful coordination, we support families in moving forward with intention. We help preserve stability, maintain continuity, and carry forward what matters across generations.

leadership.name: Priskilla Lusina
leadership.featuredQuote: Priskilla Lusina's work is rooted in a simple belief: that wealth, when guided with care, becomes more than accumulation—it becomes continuity, meaning, and responsibility carried forward.
paragraphs: Priskilla approaches wealth management as a deep personal journey, shaped by trust, understanding, and ethical stewardship. Working closely with families, she ensures that each decision is taken with clarity and intention. Today, as CEO and founder of PLUS Advisor, she extends this philosophy into a broader, more integrated approach that reflects the evolving needs of those she serves.

In her individual capacity, Priskilla is a licensed Individual Investment Adviser (Penasihat Investasi Orang Perseorangan) registered with Financial Services Authority of Indonesia (OJK), a member of FPSB Indonesia, and a Certified Financial Planner (CFP). Her professional path, built through years of experience and reflection, led to the founding of PLUS Advisor—an expression of her values, grounded in integrity, clarity, and a long-term commitment to families and their continuity.

Her recent recognition as the "Top Wealth Management Service Provider in APAC 2024", awarded by Financial Service Review, reflects the trust she has cultivated over time. For Priskilla, true success is not defined solely by growth, but by the ability to live with a peaceful mind. This belief continues to shape PLUS Advisor's family-first approach, where every step is guided with care, offering continuity, quiet confidence, and a thoughtfully assured experience.

mindsetPlanning.intro: Our advisory approach is guided by clarity, structure, and a long-term perspective. Working hand in hand with families, we move through a considered process—where priorities become clear, direction finds alignment, and decisions are taken with a sense of confidence that is both steady and assured.
mindsetPlanning.title: Mindset, Analysis,
paragraphs: We begin by working hand in hand with each family, understanding the values that guide their decisions, the priorities they hold, and what they seek to carry forward. Through this process, a shared perspective is formed so that every step ahead is aligned with intention and clarity.

From there, we take a careful and independent view of the present, reviewing existing structures, assets, governance, and potential risks. Each element is considered in relation to one another, allowing us to develop a clear and grounded understanding of the family's current position.

With this foundation, we continue to work hand in hand in shaping a clear direction, integrating structural, governance, and asset considerations into a cohesive framework. Each advice is made with due care, ensuring it remains adaptable, considered, and aligned with continuity over time.
bullets: Working hand in hand with families in overseeing assets, investments, and financial records—ensuring each element is understood, well maintained, and aligned with a broader direction.
Providing considered advisory on tax matters, business evolution, and investment decisions, with each recommendation shaped by both present needs and long-term implications.
Supporting families in planning ahead, so what has been built may be carried forward with clarity, intention, and lasting value across generations.

items.title: Sustainable Framework of Wealth Management
items.body: At Plus Advisor, our commitment to a sustainable approach forms the foundation of our STAR Value. We understand the importance of nurturing your family's well-being for generations to come, while helping you build a legacy that will be cherished by your loved ones. Our dedication extends beyond financial advice. We are committed to delivering quality, integrity, and lasting value in every aspect of your financial journey.

items.title: Trustworthy with Years of Reputable Experience
items.body: Trust is the cornerstone of our STAR Value. Backed by years of experience and a proven track record, we have established ourselves as trusted stewards of our clients' financial aspirations. Count on us to guide you through every stage of your journey, ensuring that each decision is made with your best interests at heart.

items.title: Accountable and Transparent Access for Both Sides
items.body: Accountability and transparency rest at the heart of our approach. Just like the comforting embrace of a family, we foster open and honest communication. Our commitment is to provide you with a clear, unobstructed view of your journey as well as quality insights and guidance that enhance your overall quality of life.

items.title: Reliable to Achieve Common Goals and Benefits
items.body: Reliability forms the essence of our STAR Value. We're not just advisors; we're your partners in this family-centric voyage. Together, let's strive to achieve shared goals and reap mutual benefits, ensuring your family's enduring success while enhancing the overall quality of your life.

integrityCompliance.title: Integrity, Compliance, and Confidentiality
paragraphs: At PLUS Advisor, integrity underpins every aspect of our work. We operate in alignment with applicable laws and regulations, prevailing professional standards, and principles of good governance, ensuring that each engagement is conducted with accountability, transparency, and due care.

Compliance is embedded within our processes and decision-making, not merely as an obligation, but as a disciplined approach to safeguarding the interests of the families we serve and maintaining the trust placed in us.

Confidentiality is upheld as a fundamental responsibility. All information entrusted to PLUS Advisor is handled with strict discretion and protected through appropriate internal controls and protocols designed to preserve its confidentiality and integrity.

Access to confidential information is limited to authorized parties on a need-to-know basis, ensuring that confidentiality remains secure. Through this commitment, we provide an environment where privacy is respected and where clients may proceed with clarity and confidence.

testimonials.text:
Accountable. Responsible. Reliable. Talented. No-nonsense. Thoughtful. Kind-hearted. These are just a few qualities that describe Priskilla, whom I've known since her days at Citibank. Her rapid career progression reflects her integrity and passion for helping and guiding people like me, and many others, who aren't well-versed in financial management. 

 Now, as she builds her own business, it's clear her drive remains unwavering. I deeply respect her. Meeting Priskilla has been a blessing. With patience and care, she helped me recover after a significant investment loss. I firmly believe that with her steadfast faith and hard work, Priskilla will lead PLUS Advisor into a future filled with blessings.
testimonials.author: Mr. J.T.

testimonials.text: My impression has been very positive, right from the initial process. Ms. Priskilla's approach felt exclusive, as I knew the clients involved were significant. With this gallery concept, it feels like we can truly express ourselves. Moreover, Ms. Pris is very accommodating to the many ideas from everyone involved, not just me. There are many great individuals in their respective fields. Another impression I have is that Ms. Pris really knows how to hire top-notch experts in their fields.

She deeply respects all professions, knowing the boundaries between the various roles involved in planning. Most importantly, she is eager and quick to learn. This is the key aspect of everything. Above all, she is an excellent conductor in orchestrating our teamwork.

Neat appearance, transparent tasks, and open communication are prioritized. Smiling through challenges spreads positivity. testimonials.text: Ms. Priskilla's leadership at Plus Advisor instilled crucial values that shaped my professional approach. She emphasized focus, time management, discipline, transparency, and honest communication. Her teachings on perseverance turned challenges into growth opportunities, promoting a positive attitude and concise communication. Consistency, commitment, personal presentation, and integrity were paramount. Her guidance profoundly influenced my personal and professional growth within the company.
testimonials.author: Mr. R.S.

testimonials.text:
My experience with Ms. Priskilla has been truly remarkable. Since before the founding of PLUS Advisor, she has profoundly influenced my life. Introduced to her through my father, who valued her guidance during his retirement, I quickly learned to appreciate her insightful counsel. 

 Returning to Indonesia from America in 2014 marked a significant career and lifestyle change for my husband and me. With substantial retirement funds from America, Ms. Priskilla provided invaluable advice on securing our health and planning for our children's education. Her strategic approach ensured stability during our early years in Balikpapan, where we still had income. As we transitioned to Bandung, her guidance became even more critical, allowing us to comfortably manage our finances without steady employment. 

  Beyond financial matters, Ms. Priskilla's support extended to personal and professional aspects of our lives. She facilitated connections with skilled professionals for our family hotel project, demonstrating her dedication and expertise. Her holistic approach, understanding of our needs, and ability to provide sound advice have made a profound impact, fostering trust and gratitude over our decade-long relationship.
testimonials.author: Ms. R.W.P.

paragraphs: Mountains endure through time. They hold what is precious within, shaped by patience, weight, and restraint. The gold inside a mountain does not last by chance—it remains only when treated with purpose.
At Plus Advisor, we believe wealth is much the same. It is more than numbers or achievement. It carries a family's values, aspirations, and responsibility for what must endure beyond one generation.

Founded by Priskilla Lusina, whose work has been shaped by more than 25 years of experience, Plus Advisor was established to serve families who seek clarity and care in decisions that matter. Our role is not to pursue transactions or short-term outcomes, but to provide thoughtful, long-term guidance grounded in trust and understanding.

We support families across governance, succession, philanthropy, and long-term investment considerations—approaching each decision with discipline, respect, and attention to what has been entrusted. Like gold within a mountain, wealth requires care to remain meaningful.
Plus Advisor exists to provide that care. Because legacies that last are shaped quietly, over time, with purpose.

familyOffice.title: Family Office
familyOffice.subtitle: Guided with Clarity, Carried with Care.
familyOffice.heading: PLUS Advisor, a Multi-Family Office
paragraphs: A multi-family office is designed to support families in managing and sustaining their wealth through a more integrated approach. It brings together financial, structural, and generational considerations within a cohesive framework, ensuring decisions are not made in isolation, but aligned with broader, long-term objectives.

At PLUS Advisor, our role extends beyond finance. We work closely with families, understanding values and aspirations, supporting each step with clarity and diligence, ensuring each decision reflects not only strategy, but purpose.

Our role encompasses a broader advisory perspective, assisting families in navigating significant decisions across both financial and personal dimensions. This includes advice around personal pursuits, property considerations, and long-term projects, where we provide considered input, help align the appropriate expertise, and ensure each step remains structured and grounded within a responsible financial management.
advisoryParagraphs: This approach is reflected across a comprehensive range of advisory areas. In wealth planning, we provide guidance on estate planning—including lifetime gifting, life insurance, prenuptial arrangements, and wills—as well as succession planning to support the continuity of family businesses. In wealth management, we advise on investment strategy and asset allocation, private equity considerations, consolidated reporting, and independent investment advice. Our tax planning support includes guidance on tax filings, real estate structuring, international relocation, and planning across double tax treaty frameworks.

We also advise on family governance, including the establishment of family councils, constitutions, and assemblies to support clarity in communication and decision-making. Through trust and corporate considerations, we provide advice on corporate structuring, trust administration, real estate management, ownership structures, family shareholding, as well as specialized assets. Beyond this, we support families in charity and philanthropy, including giving strategies and the formation of grant-making foundations, ensuring that impact is carried forward with intention.

principles.title: Map Your Route
principles.body: Chart a course and navigate wisely towards your destination.

ascent.closing: With Plus Advisor, you're not just a client; you're part of a family. Our holistic approach, consisting of these key steps, is designed to nurture your family's financial well-being, protect your legacy, and provide the ultimate peace of mind. At Plus Advisor, we're committed to helping your family achieve just that.

phases.title: Blueprint
phases.subtitle: Designing Your Family's Financial Legacy
phases.body: In the Blueprint phase, we lay the foundation for your family's financial success. We provide family management facilities, assist in analyzing your assets, and craft an estate plan that ensures your legacy endures.

phases.title: Structuring
phases.subtitle: Building a Sustainable Financial Framework
phases.body: The Structuring phase focuses on creating a sustainable financial framework for your family. We provide guidance on tax structuring, family constitutions, wealth management models, and help ensure transparency and efficiency.

phases.title: Protection
phases.subtitle: Securing Your Wealth and Legacy
phases.body: In the Protection phase, we establish legal documentation and assist in applying for tax incentives, safeguarding your family's wealth and legacy.

phases.title: Support System
phases.subtitle: Your Trusted Partner in Financial Success
phases.body: Our role does not end with advice—it extends to being your trusted support system. We provide guidance and consultation for family members on investment-related matters. We believe in the power of a quiet mind, ensuring peace of mind throughout your family's financial journey.
